 print('P21_PHASE',json.dumps(args),flush=True)

 return result.returncode

git fetch origin work/p2-1-formal-proof-20261125 && git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD && python3 - <<'P21_BUCHSTAB_VERIFY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
plan=json.loads(Path('docs/verification/20261125-p2-1/TARGETS.json').read_text())
for row in plan['modules']:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(row['source']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['source_sha256'],row['module']
base='/workspace/p2-private-20261124/.lake/p2-private/native-cache/staged-45362510169/qualifications/attempt-003/EXTERNAL_SNAPSHOT.json'
argv=['python3','verification/part2/extend_p21_buchstab_native_snapshot.py','--snapshot',base,'--snapshot-sha256','ad4386f160e7d59bcaca2820fb9123434d05593595b266ca24fa742e48367d27']
print('P21_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION_COMMAND',json.dumps(argv),flush=True)
r=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print(r.stdout,flush=True);print('P21_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION_EXIT',r.returncode,flush=True)
if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
result=json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]);assert result['modules']==518 and result['compile_credit'] is False and result['kernel_credit'] is False
p=Path(result['snapshot']);assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==result['sha256']
destination=Path('.lake/p2-private/p21-buchstab-extension-result.json')
if destination.exists():assert json.loads(destination.read_text())==result,'Earlier extension result differs; refusing overwrite.'
else:destination.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
root=plan['roots'][3]['module'];names=[row['module'] for row in plan['modules'] if root in row['used_by_roots']]
assert len(names)==8 and all(row['used_by_roots']==[root] for row in plan['modules'] if row['module'] in names)
codes=[]
for argv in [
 ['python3','verification/part2/run_winner9_private_checks.py',root,'--workers','1','--threads','1','--memory-mb','11264','--time-budget-seconds','900','--external-snapshot',str(p)],
 ['python3','verification/part2/run_winner9_private_audit.py',*names,'--memory-mb','11264','--summary-name','p21-audit-buchstab.json','--external-snapshot',str(p)]]:
 print('P21_BUCHSTAB_PHASE',json.dumps(argv),flush=True);r=subprocess.run(argv);codes.append(r.returncode);print('P21_BUCHSTAB_PHASE_EXIT',r.returncode,flush=True)
print('P21_BUCHSTAB_EXIT_CODES',json.dumps(codes),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(int(any(codes)))
